sampling.ordering: Within each persona, ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 seed + NUL + caseId, then caseId.
sampling.outcomeBlind: The selector may read identity, period, task, forgetting-bearing flag, candidate ids, and token counts. It must not read any per-case metric, answer, judge verdict, or improvement value.
